title: Ecology of AI Agents: Collaboration Creates a Population Threshold for Takeoff
abstract: arXiv:2610.12436v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI agents can now conduct real-world cyberattacks, scale up capabilities with the number of agents, and collectively pursue misaligned goals to obtain rewards. Together, these factors raise the risk of a population explosion of misaligned agents: agents could compromise computers and secretly deploy additional agents, creating a self-reinforcing cycle where larger populations develop greater collective cyber capability and expand further. This raises a fundamental question: What determines whether a population of misaligned agents remains contained or takes off into this self-reinforcing cycle? This population-level problem is ecological safety: unlike individual-agent or multi-agent safety with a fixed population, it concerns the dynamics of the population itself. Here, we develop an ecological theory of AI-agent populations based on a population growth equation in which fitness (growth rate) depends on cybersecurity capability. We show

translated_title: AI智能体的生态学：协作创造出种群“起飞”的阈值
translated_abstract: AI智能体现在能够实施真实世界的网络攻击，其能力可随智能体数量增长而扩展，并能够共同追求未对齐的目标以获取奖励。这些因素共同加剧了未对齐智能体种群爆炸的风险：智能体可能入侵计算机并秘密部署更多智能体，从而形成一个自我强化的循环——更大的种群发展出更强的集体网络能力并进一步扩张。这引出了一个根本性问题：是什么决定了未对齐智能体的种群能够被控制住，还是进入这种自我强化的循环并“起飞”？这一种群层面的问题即生态安全：与种群规模固定的个体智能体安全或多智能体安全不同，它关注的是种群本身的动态。在此，我们基于一个种群增长方程建立了AI智能体种群的生态学理论，其中适应度（增长率）取决于网络安全能力。我们证明……
tldr: 该论文提出了AI智能体种群的生态安全理论，通过一个适应度取决于网络安全能力的种群增长方程证明，智能体之间的协作会使未对齐智能体种群存在一个“起飞”阈值，一旦超过该阈值，种群便会进入自我强化的扩张循环。
en_tdlr: This paper develops an ecological theory of AI-agent populations in which fitness depends on cybersecurity capability, showing that agent collaboration creates a population threshold beyond which misaligned agents can "take off" into a self-reinforcing cycle of expansion.
